propositions: The live external integration rejects openai-chat model specs because the resolver canonicalizes openai to openai-chat but the credential map has no openai-chat entry, causing live_llm_ready() to return False and all tests to skip

The provider guard at test_provider_matrix_live.py:88 compares resolved specs literally against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' but configured_provider() returns 'openai-chat' after commit 8f4c5fdb0d3, triggering an AssertionError
The unit-tier matrix gate was updated with a family-to-qualifier mapping in commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 but the live external tier's consumers were not updated, violating the contract obligation

Adding a qualifier-to-family mapping in the live tier and returning provider FAMILY from configured_provider() aligns credential lookup, readiness checks, and guard assertions with the declared arm provider without changing which provider the arm runs
